findings.description: T048 requires a size limit on callbacks. delivery.ts drops an event whose webhook body exceeds MAX_WEBHOOK_BYTES (262144) and logs delivery_event_not_sendable. No test in delivery.test.ts, callback-transport.test.ts or events.test.ts exercises this branch (grep for MAX_WEBHOOK_BYTES in tests returns nothing). The transport tests cover only the response cap. Add a test that an oversize event sends nothing, is logged by id only, and does not block other events.
findings.title: T048 outbound request size bound has no test

findings.description: T051 asks for each client's delivery state, kept across a restart, with tests for restart, two clients and an old-epoch cursor. cursor-store.test.ts covers marks (restart, two clients and locations, forward-only, epoch replacement). subscriptions-store.test.ts covers sealing, renewal, expiry, removal by the owning client and key replacement, but no test reopens a new SubscriptionsStore over the same database and checks that another client's subscription state is unchanged, and no test asserts what delivery state is stored per client. The delivery.test.ts harness uses a single in-memory database and never restarts. Add a restart test for subscription and delivery state.
findings.title: T051 per-client delivery state lacks a restart and isolation test

summary: Governance verification passed (exit 0). Compared T043, T048 and T051 tests with their acceptance criteria. T043 outbox tests cover ack-removes-exactly-one, the 50-event window, 10 s doubling to 300 s, jitter at both extremes, backlog count and age, and restart, and match outbox-store.ts. T048 delivery and transport tests cover host/HTTPS/port/credentials refusal, private-address refusal, no redirects, response size cap, timeout, signature, retries, 410/413, client isolation, expiry and revocation, and sealed storage. T051 cursor tests cover restart, client and location isolation, forward-only marks, and epoch replacement; events-read tests cover gap-free paging and epoch_changed. Two minor test gaps found. Not examined: the round-seven public-contract.test.ts get_events case, events.test.ts beyond its test titles, and the 14 test files the glob did not list. Round is partial for those reasons.
